route_steps.goal: Same initial/state/source/normalization matched Bianchi I and FLRW pair; certify tensor/work and photon propagation with geometry feedback within selected scope.

route_steps.goal: Extract actual optical depth/visibility and a directional (Bianchi) observable with uncertainty/source/model separation.

optional_lanes.qualification: Require overlapping EoR source support, named state/density/clock and temperature collider range, unique event/energy ownership, and sensitivity relevant to a declared observable error budget. If no actual consumer, keep source research archived and reusable without blocking core.

accountability.progress_meaning: An original scientific node completes only when its named source-qualified consumer and physical acceptance artifacts pass; R/C stage counts, rows, plots, ZIPs, reviews, Draft PRs and auxiliary scopes are NOT increments.
accountability.before_new_side_unit: State exact REI consumer, source/clock overlap, expected change to central or WU canonical, or explicitly mark LEGACY/EXPLORATORY and return to core after the unit.
accountability.drift_watchdog: After two successive process-only or ancillary units with zero core delta, stop optional repetition and choose shortest executable CORE_NOW action. Exception: explicit new user-selected science scope; never forbid open exploration.
